definition: An RSVP object that carries the label assigned to a label switched path, traveling upstream in Resv messages. Its value is defined by the companion functional description RFC 3471 and can name a time slot, a wavelength or a fiber rather than a packet label.
plainLanguage: The name of the circuit a path uses; in GMPLS it can be a time slot, a wavelength or a fiber, not just a packet label.
